Announcements


Superb Academy Is Live: Learn Superb Platform in One Place


Hyun Kim


Co-Founder & CEO | 2026/09/02 | 3 min read


[Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/superb-ai/)[X(twitter)](https://x.com/superb_hq)


Superb AI has launched a new[\[Superb Academy\] page](https://superb-ai.com/en/resources/academy) —a learning hub with 26 short videos covering the complete data workflow in the Superb Platform, from project creation and labeling collaboration to Auto-Label, data curation, and exploration.


# **The Full Workflow, Broken Down into Six Chapters**


The videos are organized into six chapters that follow the actual data workflow:


- Getting Started (6 videos)
- Collaboration & Project Management (5 videos)
- Label Export (3 videos)
- Auto-Label (2 videos)
- Auto-Curate (5 videos)
- Data Exploration & Use (5 videos)


Snapshot of the first video in Superb Academy


Each video is around four minutes long, making it easy to work through the series from beginning to end—or jump straight to the feature you need.


# **Videos, Transcripts, Timelines, and User Guides**


Each video page includes the full transcript, so you can quickly scan the content or find the information you need without playing the entire video.


A timeline provides an at-a-glance overview of the video, while related user guides let you explore each topic in greater depth. On the Korean version of the Academy, we have also curated relevant *Superb Recipe* articles featuring practical tips and workflows.


# **Available in Korean, English, and Japanese**


Superb Academy pages and full video transcripts are available in Korean, English, and Japanese, making it easy for teammates across different languages to onboard with the same curriculum.


# **How to Use Superb Academy**


- Use it as onboarding material for new team members.
- If you are considering adopting the Superb Platform, preview the workflow through actual product screens.
- When getting started with a specific feature such as Auto-Label or Auto-Curate, go directly to the relevant chapter and learn only what you need.


Want to try the features you saw in the videos with your own data? Tell us about your data type and target task below, and we’ll help you find the right setup.
